title: Thai Berry Crumble
description: A delicious dessert that combines the flavors of Thailand with the sweetness of berries topped with a crunchy crumble.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the berries and Thai Red Curry Paste.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the granulated sugar and flour.
Add the dry mixture to the berry mixture and stir until combined.
Transfer the mixture to a 9-inch baking dish.
In another bowl, mix together the unsalted butter, oat flour, brown sugar, and chopped almonds until crumbly.
Spread the crumble mixture evenly over the berry mixture.
Bake for 40-45 minutes or until the topping is golden brown and the fruit is bubbly.
Serve warm with vanilla ice cream or whipped cream if desired.
